evidence_basis: Re-read of the held delivered surface (chunks 0, 1, 2, 18, 22, 23, 24, 25) for one question set: which patients have a diet, vigabatrin or hormonal entry, what outcome is printed for each, and whether a developmental course is printed. Chunks 3 to 17, which carry the narratives of patients 1 to 4, are absent from this surface; methods is marked read for the delivered parts only.
